summary: IDS feed s056_single is degraded due to excessive duplicate packets (23.2% - 1006/4334) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, overload, encryption, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is aggregating the same traffic from multiple SPAN/mirror or TAP paths without deduplication, delivering identical packets twice to the IDS tool port. 23.2% duplicate rate indicates overlapping capture points or looped aggregation.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes CPU and memory processing 23% duplicate packets, inflates flow tables and signature matches, creates duplicate alerts/noise, and risks missing real attacks due to resource exhaustion despite needing full payload and both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker-level deduplication within a short time window to drop identical packets before delivery to the 1Gbps IDS port, eliminating wasted processing and restoring accurate detection coverage.
